mission_fit.rationale: A body-on-frame 4WD with low range and an included platform roof rack directly serves the rooftop-tent camping intent the RX can't. The tent is available for $1,000 and the asking price is within the ideal band. High mileage and an unknown trim keep it short of decisive.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A typical refreshed GX460 in brown over tan. The quality platform rack is a modest plus for the stated camping use. Trim and package are unknown.

ppi_focus: Full OBD scan including pending and history codes and readiness monitors. Watch for SAI codes (P2440/P2442/P0418).
Cold start to listen for air injection pump operation and noise.
Valley-plate coolant leak check at rear of engine, timing-cover seepage, water pump and radiator.
Frame, crossmembers, brake lines and rear suspension mounts for rust and scale.
KDSS accumulators, lines and cylinders for leaks and level stance (if equipped).
Transfer case actuator operation and low-range engagement, center diff lock function.
Transmission fluid condition and hitch-area frame given the visible tow receiver.
Front control arm bushings, shocks and steering components at 175k.
Roof rack mounting points and seals, headliner for water stains.
Tire date codes and tread depth; check for uneven wear.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a VIN with a clean history report and a dealer service printout showing regular fluids, plugs and coolant.
Up: documented SAI repair or a clean scan with readiness monitors set, plus clean underside photos.
Up: a clean independent PPI arranged before money moves.
Down: active SAI codes, KDSS leaks, valley-plate coolant loss, or frame scale found in inspection.
Down: seller refusal of VIN or PPI, or heavy towing history revealed.
evidence.mission_note: Fits the capability branch genuinely. Body-on-frame 4WD with low range plus an included platform roof rack (and optional OVS tent) supplies rooftop-tent camping capability the RX 350 lacks. The case rests on unproven maintenance at 175k miles.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a refreshed GX460 with an odometer photo matching 174,994 miles, a straight and clean exterior, stock ride height, an included aftermarket platform roof rack and a visible tow hitch. Asking is $19,000 after a $1,000 cut, at the fair-value mid of $19,333. Nothing mechanically wrong is observed or stated beyond disclosed minor scratches. Everything else rests on seller prose: clean title, no damage, 'never missed an oil change', and tires with 'plenty of life'. There is no VIN, no history report and no service records. All four model-critical items (SAI status, KDSS, frame/underbody condition, and a scan for warning lights) remain open. The single dash photo shows no amber lamp but is not a scan. Trim and owner count are not established; the tracker's 'Sport' trim and '1 owner' are not in the listing text.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, service records or a dealer service printout, and underside photos, and confirm he will permit an independent PPI in the Fayetteville area before any deposit.
